correctness.rationale: Reconstructed R_n=A_n x A_n from join of two discrete n-point complexes. The simultaneous rotation acts freely on all positive-dimensional cubical cells: any such cell has a variable coordinate that must be fixed. Quotient cells are (N_n(4),4^n,n*4^(n-1)). Basepoint at an all-minus cube vertex makes the cube graph-to-necklace graph quotient pi_1-surjective by edge-by-edge lifting; using axes and product projection gives H_1(Q)=Z^(2r_n). Since Q is a 2D CW complex, H_2 is a free subgroup of C_2 and Euler characteristic gives rank s_n. Projection to B_n x B_n is surjective on integral H_2 by surjective graph H_1 and Kunneth, so the cross-degree-one cup-product lattice is primitive. Independently recalculated for n=3,4,5,6: N2=(4,6,8,14), N4=(24,70,208,700), (2r,s)=(2,9),(6,75),(18,481),(38,2785), extra cup-indecomposables=(8,66,400,2424). Computations are calibration; the all-n proof uses the exact cell and homology maps.
